scripts.preview: astro build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name wren-lander
scripts.db:alter: wrangler d1 execute wren-leads --remote --command "alter table leads add column name text; alter table leads add column questions text"
scripts.leads: wrangler d1 execute wren-leads --remote --command "select ts, niche, name, email, phone, utm_campaign, country, note, questions from leads order by ts desc limit 50"
scripts.hits: wrangler d1 execute wren-leads --remote --command "select page, count(*) views, sum(w < 840) mobile, round(avg(depth)) depth, round(avg(secs)) secs, sum(cta) cta, sum(touched) touched from hits where secs >= 2 group by page order by views desc"
scripts.hits:campaign: wrangler d1 execute wren-leads --remote --command "select utm_campaign, count(*) views, round(avg(depth)) depth, sum(cta) cta, sum(touched) touched from hits where secs >= 2 group by utm_campaign order by views desc"
scripts.forget: wrangler d1 execute wren-leads --remote --command "delete from leads where email = '$EMAIL'"
